rv.q: Magnus isn't on stage often enough so don't miss this show...
If you can maintain focus over the brief forty-five-minute runtime, you will be justly rewarded.
Even though the average college professor or preacher could not have pulled off as amusing a presentation as this one, the show left me empty and unfulfilled.

cn.t: Jenny Magnus delivers an intelligent, surreal solo exploration of virtue and morality that impresses with its depth and ambition, though some find the philosophical meditation more scattered than cohesive.
